title: Project config v1
description: One board's geometry, stackup, net classes and synthesis policy — the file `blpl init` writes and Stage 5 reads. Hand-authored, so this schema is the only thing standing between a typo and a board of the wrong size: Stage 5 used to read dimensions with `.get(...) or [100, 80]`, which turned a misspelled key into a silent 100x80 board that built and shipped without complaint.

dimensions.description: Board width and height in mm. Exactly two numbers: a one-element list is a typo, not a square board.

items.description: Millimetres. The upper bound is a fat-finger guard — no fab in this pipeline's reach panelises past 2 m, and a stray zero is the likeliest way to reach one.

layers.description: Copper layers. Odd counts are not manufacturable, so the enum is the whole list rather than a range.

net_classes.description: Trace and via geometry per class. Stage 4 assigns every unmatched net to Default, so Default has to exist or the emitted .kicad_pro names a class that does not.

diff_pair_width.description: Width of each trace of a differential pair, when it differs from trace_width.

diff_pair_gap.description: Edge-to-edge gap inside a differential pair. Sets a differential impedance as much as the width does.

coplanar_gap.description: Gap from a coplanar line to the ground pour on either side. Sets a coplanar impedance as much as the width does.

controlled_impedance.description: Which nets need controlled impedance, by name. Each entry lands its nets on an impedance class: the one it names, or the one declared with the same target. 50 ohms single-ended unless it says otherwise.

net_class_rules.description: Patterns applied over Stage 4's name-based guess. First match wins.

board_outline.description: The board's edge. With 'shape' it is drawn, and project.dimensions must equal its bounding box. The legacy 'type: rect' form with start/end was never read; dimensions decides for it.

cutouts.description: Holes and slots through the board, wholly inside the outline. A notch in the edge belongs in board_outline instead.

keepouts.description: Board-level rule areas. Default: every copper layer, everything forbidden.

copper_zones.description: Copper planes. A list of {net, layer} (optionally polygon) is exactly those planes; 'none' is none; 'auto' or an empty list gives a board of four or more layers ground on In1.Cu and its busiest supply rail on In2.Cu (core/planes.py).

policy.description: none — synthesise nothing. power — one per power/ground net. all — one per net with a pad.

assembly.description: How each part is built, where it is not simply bought and placed. dnp: the footprint is on the board but the part is not fitted (marked DNP, out of the BOM and the placement file). footprint_only: copper only, nothing is bought or placed — a Tag-Connect pad pattern, a test pad, a jumper made by the board itself.

references.description: fit (the default): a reference stays in silk only when it fits on its own part. hidden: none in silk; they stay on F.Fab, the assembly drawing.

labels.description: Silk text a person must read on the finished board, by part: shown where that part's reference would be. Example: {BT_POS: '+', J_RF_GNSS: GNSS}.

label_size.description: Label text height in mm (default and minimum 0.8, KiCad's silk minimum).

clip_to_copper.description: Trim footprints' silk graphics where they cross the footprint's own pads, as the fab's mask clipping would.

placement.description: What the placer cannot infer. A hint is an instruction: someone wrote it knowing something the netlist does not say.

edge_margin.description: Millimetres every part's courtyard keeps from the board edge (default 1.0). Applied to the parts the placer positions and checked for the ones a hint pins.

near.description: Refdes to sit beside. Outranks both the netlist and the naming convention.

edge.description: Board edge this part sits against: a connector's mating side, a module's antenna end. rot says which way the part faces.

impedance.description: This class is impedance-controlled, and its widths are for this target. true means 50 ohms single-ended; a number is ohms.

layers.description: Copper layers this class's width is for. Required on boards with more than two copper layers.

reference.description: Plane layers the width was calculated against. Default: the layers next to the routed one.

anchor.description: Refdes whose footprint frame the shape is in. The shape follows the part through placement.

shape.description: One shape, in board-local mm: origin top-left, y down. Checked fully by core/blpl/core/board_geometry.py; this catches the missing field.
